title: HEIF Image Extensions Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

descriptions.value: In multiple locations, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds read via an attestation comparison oracle due to an incorrect bounds check. This could lead to local information disclosure with System execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

affected.product: Intel(R) Server Board D50DNP and Intel(R) Server Board M50FCP

descriptions.value: Out-of-bounds write in the XmlCliCommonDxe for the Intel(R) Server Board D50DNP and Intel(R) Server Board M50FCP within Ring 0 UEFI may allow an escalation of privilege. Startup code and smm adversary with a privileged user combined with a high complexity attack may enable local code execution. This result may potentially occur via local access when attack requirements are present without special internal knowledge and requires no user interaction. The potential vulnerability may impact the confidentiality (high), integrity (high) and availability (high) of the vulnerable system, resulting in subsequent system confidentiality (high), integrity (high) and availability (high) impacts.
